initial_issues.detail: Windows sandbox asyncio socketpair initialization blocked; faulthandler located the wait; the same requests and tests passed under normal permissions.
Running scripts/verify_http.py as a file did not put the project package on the import path. The published command uses python -m scripts.verify_http and passed.
Installed Starlette deprecated httpx for TestClient. Replaced it with httpx2 and regenerated the lock file without suppressing warnings.
